_comment: Ghost types. drops: a killed ghost leaves ONE of the listed entries, chosen at random with equal chance. damage: multiplier per damage kind (plain, fire, wind, lightning) applied to roundDamage. Rounds whose effect does no damage of its own (haze, fog, the voodoo rounds) count as plain; see 'damage' on each element in elements.json. Health is in the same units as roundDamage. hitstop: seconds a hit holds the ghost (and what hit it) still, from min for a graze to max for a kill; things that hit continuously (fire, breath) only do it on first contact.

wisp._comment: It lures: hangs lureDistance away and backs off when approached. It rushes when you look away for lookAwayTime or come within rushTrigger, and bursts on reaching you (burstDamage is a fraction of the player's health). A burst wisp drops nothing.

poltergeist._comment: Unseen. It haunts a spot (wanderRadius around it) and lifts loose things within grabRange, holds them for holdTime, then hurls them at throwSpeed. throwDamage is the fraction of health a hit from a 6 kg object costs (heavier hurts more). cooldown is the pause between throws.

ballLightning._comment: Until it notices someone it floats round its haunt (wanderRadius) at wanderSpeed, throwing nothing. Then: it hangs at hoverHeight for chargeTime, drifting at driftSpeed, throwing volleys of arcsPerVolley arcs every arcEvery s at terrain within arcReach. An arc crackles on its spot for arcDelay s, then strikes: a player within arcRadius takes arcDamage (fraction of health). Then it jumps hops times, hopEvery s apart, hopMin..hopMax m each in a zig-zag; within circleRange of a player it hops round them at about circleRadius. It cannot be hit mid-burst. Hurt, it gets away with a burst after flinchTime.

mimic._comment: It lies on the floor looking like any material, or (boxChance) a small box. Out of its disguise it carries its core standHeight above where it clings, and bullets hit a sphere of radius (above) round that core; disguised, one of disguisedRadius round the thing it looks like. Someone within revealNear for revealLinger s in all, or holding to pick it up for revealGrab s, or a hit gives it away: it thrashes for revealTime s (anyone within revealRadius is struck once for revealDamage and thrown back at revealShove m/s) and hunts. It does not charge: each dash (burstSpeed for burstMin..burstMax s, gathering pace at acceleration m/s^2 and turning at most turnRate rad/s) takes it to a spot spotMin..spotMax m from its quarry that is hidden from them, behind them, or by something to climb on the side they cannot see; it only pauses (pauseMin..pauseMax s) where it is unseen. It climbs to climbHeight above their feet and drops on them within dropRange, or leaps from up there; on the floor between leapMin and leapMax it leaps (leapSpeed) when they are not looking. After patience s of stalking it goes in regardless. A leap or drop that passes within leapHitRadius of someone costs them leapDamage and shoves them at leapShove m/s. Within thrashRange it winds up for thrashWindup s, then hits everyone within thrashReach for thrashDamage (fraction of health), shoving them at thrashShove m/s; thrashCooldown s before the next. dodgeChance (above): of sidestepping a shot it sees coming. It keeps track of a quarry within senseRange without seeing them. Having perceived nobody for memory s (and with nobody that near; at once if they shroud) it runs fleeMin..fleeMax m to somewhere out of sight and takes concealTime s to become a new disguise. When it dies it leaves the drops, or with dropDisguiseChance the material it pretended to be.

vasskraka._comment: A flock of sharp black shards. It roosts as a clump on the nearest wall within roostSearch (flying there at returnSpeed). Noticing someone it flies to them at flySpeed and circles them (for at least firstAttack s before it first attacks) at circleRadius and circleHeight, slowing to circleSpeed, attacking every attackEvery s or so: a dive (diveWindup s drawing back, then diveSpeed through them; passing within diveRadius costs diveDamage of their health and shoves them at diveShove), or with ballChance (never twice running) the ball (gatherTime s forming ballHeight over them, then it drops, drifting after them at fallLean m/s^2, and bursts: up to burstDamage within burstRadius with a clear line, shoving at burstShove; reformTime s to gather itself again). dodgeChance (above): of scattering into a cloud nothing can hit for scatterTime s, gathering scatterDistance away; a hit scatters it too. Its size is its health as a share of 'health' (never drawn smaller than minSize): damage and reach scale with it. Two within mergeRange, both below full health, merge (never above maxHealth times 'health'). Hit by a player other than its quarry with more than splitAbove of its health, it divides in two halves (not again for splitCooldown s). A gust or blast costs it pushDamage health per m/s it is shoved (never the last of it).

necromite._comment: A worm. Co-op only: when a player goes down (and someone else still stands), with spawnChance one comes up out of the ground spawnDelay s later, spawnMin..spawnMax m from the body. It takes emergeTime s to come up, crawls at crawlSpeed to the head, and within enterRange goes in over enterTime s. Any hit kills it (health 1, a small target). In, it raises the body as a zombie (below), which has its own health; while it stands, that player cannot be revived. When the zombie is put down the worm dies with it and the player lies there, down as before.

zombie._comment: health: as a fraction of a player (it does not mend). After riseTime s it fires the rounds left in that player revolver, one every shotEveryMin..shotEveryMax s, each spread by spreadDeg with its aim swimming by aimWander radians; rounds cast on the shooter are left. It never reloads. With the gun empty it runs at the nearest player and, between diveMin and diveRange m, jumps and diveDelay s later dives; it lies standDelay s and gets up, leapCooldown s before the next. Thrown at ramSpeed m/s or more, touching a player costs them ramDamage (fraction of health) and shoves them at ramShove m/s, once per ramCooldown s each. Its shots and its ramming hurt players whatever the friendly-fire setting, and players can always shoot it.
